name: pythia-cognitive-os
description: Disciplined reasoning and execution layer for narrow AI. Context retention, evidence discipline, anti-hallucination controls, and mastery-level coding behavior.

tools.name: session_start
tools.description: Initialize a session with mandatory skill activation and context snapshot.

tools.name: evidence_verify
tools.description: Verify that claimed evidence exists and matches its digest.

tools.name: completion_gate
tools.description: Refuse completion unless tests have passed and evidence is present.

tools.name: owner_approval
tools.description: Record an owner approval gate. Owner decision overrides interpretation.
